hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Purchasing an item grants free copies of all other items whose factors are multiples.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Calculate the total items unlocked by purchasing each initial item.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Allocate budget across optimal items and invest any remainder into the cheapest available item.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def maxSaleItemsI(items: list[list[int]], budget: int) -> int:
    n = len(items)
    cheapest = min(item[1] for item in items)
    max_ans = budget // cheapest
    for i in range(n):
        f_i, p_i = items[i]
        if p_i <= budget:
            free_count = 1 + sum(1 for j in range(n) if j != i and items[j][0] % f_i == 0)
            rem_budget = budget - p_i
            total = free_count + (rem_budget // cheapest)
            max_ans = max(max_ans, total)
    return max_ans
```
